jobs.title: Group Product Manager, B2C
jobs.description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to  getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Your mission

GetYourGuide's On-Trip product group owns the entire post-booking experience: from the moment a traveler completes checkout through fulfillment, supplier coordination, to agentic care resolution. As GPM, you will lead a group of product managers, set strategy, coach a high-performing team, and drive measurable outcomes on some of the highest-leverage surfaces in the business. What you'll own:

- On-Trip Domain: Fulfillment (contextual UX, self-service, modification and cancellation), AI Resolution (unified care and chat automation, currently resolving a significant share of contacts already with AI), and Supplier-Traveler Coordination (off-platform observability, supplier messaging, and coordination tooling).

- Manage three PMs in Zurich. You report to the Director of Product, Traveler, who is based in Berlin.

Your toolkit

- Demonstrated ability to synthesise a complex, multi-pillar strategy into a clear and opinionated thesis for executive audiences with a coherent point of view beyond executional updates.

- Experience managing and coaching junior/senior/lead PMs who own their own domains, with evidence that their output improved under your management.

- Strong commercial instinct: able to size problems with rough numbers, make ROI cases, and commit to metrics.

- Track record operating in an operationally complex domain — marketplace, payments, post-purchase, or customer service technology.

- Comfortable with occasional travel to Berlin for stakeholders and leadership engagement.

Extras that give you an edge

-  Familiarity with AI-assisted customer resolution, supplier-facing product, or payment corridors in a global marketplace.

How we’ll make your career journey extraordinary

- Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development

- Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year

- A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.

- Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events

- Monthly transportation and fitness budget

- Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities

- Language reimbursement program

- Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How to apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘ how we hire ’ and ‘ life at GetYourGuide ’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com .

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Discovery
jobs.description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to  getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

As a Lead Product Manager in our Discovery (Traveler) organization, you will be a core part of a cross-functional mission team—partnering closely with engineering, design, research, data/analytics, and peer product leaders.

Your mission

Your role is to set a clear product strategy and vision, translate it into measurable outcomes, and continuously iterate based on customer insights and data. While we care deeply about performance and metrics, we don’t optimize KPIs in isolation—we start from real traveler problems, validate them with evidence (qualitative and quantitative), and use measurement to ensure we’re delivering meaningful customer value.

We are looking for a leader who can think beyond the current product, champion the traveler perspective, and drive a compelling, coherent discovery experience across multiple surfaces. You’ll balance near-term impact with long-term systems thinking—building a strong learning agenda through experimentation and aligning cross-functional and cross-team stakeholders on priorities and trade-offs.

Successful PMs at GetYourGuide bring a growth mindset and deliver customer and business impact by identifying opportunities, building alignment, and executing with urgency.

What You'll Do

- Develop and implement a comprehensive strategy for your product area, set clear, measurable goals, and take full responsibility for outcomes. Drive sustained customer impact through a long-term (12 months+) roadmap, identifying areas for non-incremental impact.

- Articulate and connect your product area’s strategy to the company’s mission. Break down the strategy into actionable steps, regularly update stakeholders on progress, and create excitement for your long-term vision. Build alignment across cross-functional teams, partner teams, and senior stakeholders.

- Drive coherence across multiple discovery entry points (e.g., browse, landing pages, inspiration modules), balancing short-term wins with a durable information architecture and scalable content strategy.

- Synthesize customer feedback, research insights, and business metrics to identify and prioritize the most meaningful traveler problems. Define success measures and iterate based on evidence to ensure we deliver real customer value. Make strategic decisions on sequencing and prioritizing product work to maximize impact and learning.

- Build and execute an experimentation strategy—developing a robust hypothesis pipeline, defining guardrails and a learning agenda, and ensuring high-quality measurement. Use experiment outcomes to derive actionable insights, inform roadmap decisions, and align cross-team priorities and trade-offs.

- Drive end-to-end delivery, ensuring high-quality execution from discovery through launch and iteration, and enabling effective collaboration across engineering, design, research, and data.

- Build strong relationships and alignment across partner teams that influence discovery quality (e.g., Search, Recommendations, Brand/Content, Commercial). Set clear expectations, align on shared goals and trade-offs, and drive cross-functional execution against your roadmap.

- Represent the traveler perspective at all levels, communicate decisions with clarity and transparency with your team, peers, and executive leadership. Coach PMs and cross-functional partners to raise the bar on product thinking and execution and foster a culture of continuous improvement.

Your toolkit

- 6+ years of professional experience in product management and at least 2+ years as a Lead Product Manager.

- Demonstrated ability to lead with customer problems and value creation, using data and metrics to validate impact rather than as the starting point.

- Demonstrated ownership of a significant product area with responsibilities for strategy, KPI definition, goal-setting, and roadmap execution.

- Ability to build alignment with a cross-functional mission team in a collaborative way that is aligned with our Guiding Principles.

- Strong ability to lead in ambiguity, influence without authority, and align multiple teams around shared outcomes.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

- Strong data analytics skills with the ability to derive insights from large data sets.

- Demonstrated passion for driving customer and business impact.

- Bonus: Experience working in a marketplace or the travel industry is a plus, but not required.

- Bonus: Experience owning consumer discovery/browse/search-adjacent top-of-funnel product areas at scale, including SEO- and landing-page ecosystems (content, templates, indexation, and measurement) is a plus but ot required.

How we’ll make your career journey extraordinary

- Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development

- Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year

- A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.

- Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events

- Monthly transportation and fitness budget

- Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities

- Language reimbursement program

- Health and wellness benefits

And more…

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Landing Pages
jobs.description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to  getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

Landing pages are one of GetYourGuide's most important product surfaces — the moment where acquisition meets experience, and where the quality of what we build directly determines whether a visitor becomes a customer.

Your mission

As Lead Product Manager for Landing Pages, you will own a high-traffic surface that sits at the intersection of growth, acquisition, and user experience. You will work closely with paid search, paid media, and SEO stakeholders to ensure the pages you build perform across channels, while keeping the traveller's needs at the centre of every decision. Your cross-functional team includes engineers, designers, analysts, and researchers.

This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, is energised by the product-marketing boundary, and wants to build something that scales — not just ship features. The work has direct visibility into how GetYourGuide grows, and the decisions made here have a measurable impact on the business from day one.

We are looking for a Lead PM who brings both strategic clarity and executional rigour — someone who can set a vision, bring stakeholders along, and deliver.

What You'll Do

- Build modular, reusable infrastructure — page templates, content modules, and page logic — that compounds in value over time. You are not optimising individual features; you are building the foundation that makes everything that follows faster and cheaper.

- Develop and implement a strategy for your product area, set clear measurable goals, and take full responsibility for outcomes. Connect your roadmap to the company's mission, break it into actionable steps, and create genuine excitement for the long-term vision — with your team, across functions, and with executive leadership.

- Apply your understanding of acquisition channel economics and how landing page content drives channel performance. Partner closely with paid search, paid media, and SEO stakeholders to ensure pages serve channel needs without being built around any single one. Hold user experience and channel performance goals together rather than trading them off.

- Design and own an experimentation system at scale — not just individual A/B tests, but the architecture and cadence that enables rapid, parallel testing across page types and channels. Build toward a model that increases the speed and independence of experimentation over time.

- Use customer feedback, market trends, and business metrics to drive decisions. Prioritise ruthlessly, re-evaluate the roadmap as new insights arrive, and make clear calls on sequencing to maximise both impact and learning.

- Represent customer interests at all levels of the organisation. Act with openness and transparency with your team, peers, and leadership. Coach and mentor team members, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and bring others along on the vision.

Your toolkit

- 6+ years of experience in product management , with a t least 2 years as a Lead or Senior PM owning a product area end-to-end — including strategy, goal-setting, roadmap execution, and KPI accountability.

- A systems thinker who builds for scale. You have experience building product infrastructure or platforms — not just features — and you understand how foundational work compounds over time.

- Experience working at the intersection of product and marketing, growth, or acquisition. You have a working understanding of how channels like paid search, paid social, or SEO use product surfaces to drive performance, and you're comfortable holding user experience and channel performance goals together.

- Strong analytical skills with demonstrated experience in experimentation — designing testing methodology and cadence, not just interpreting results. You know how to build a testing culture and move a team toward data-informed decisions at speed.

- Proven ability to build alignment across engineering, design, analytics, and marketing stakeholders. You bring people along through clear thinking and strong communication rather than through authority.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. You can translate complex product and technical concepts for executive, marketing, and engineering audiences equally well.

- Bonus: Experience in a marketplace, e-commerce, or travel business.

- Bonus: A background in engineering or data science — particularly valuable given the technical architecture nature of this role.

How we’ll make your career journey extraordinary

- Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development

- Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year

- A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.

- Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events

- Monthly transportation and fitness budget

- Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities

- Language reimbursement program

And more…

jobs.description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to  getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

We're looking for an outstanding Lead Product Manager to join GetYourGuide's Paid Search team. In this role, you'll drive the vision, strategy, and growth of the products that power one of our largest customer acquisition channels.

Paid Search at GetYourGuide sits at the intersection of back-end automation and data products. The tech powering the channel is no longer just a set of back-end systems — it's increasingly a portfolio of data products (signals, feeds, bidding inputs, attribution) consumed by our Marketing team and by adjacent Growth surfaces. Your job is to shape that portfolio: set the strategy, define the roadmap, and partner with engineering to ship it.

You'll work closely with the Paid Search Tech engineering team, the Growth Data Product team, and the Paid Search Marketing team, who are both your closest partners and your primary internal customers. If you want to shape the future of paid customer acquisition with us, read on.

Your mission

- Ownership : You are skilled at laying out your team's strategy, setting goals, and following through — owning the outcomes of your team's work end to end.

- Ambiguity: You can create meaning and value from ambiguity, and you're comfortable operating in a space where the "product" is often a system, a signal, or a model rather than a UI.

- Data product thinking: You treat internal capabilities — bidding inputs, feeds, signals, attribution — as products with consumers, contracts, and a roadmap, not as back-end plumbing. You define what "good" looks like for the teams that depend on them.

- Communication: You demonstrate a clear and structured approach to communicating; able to connect your team's strategy to the company's mission and break it down into clear next steps for engineers, marketers, and leadership alike.

- Prioritisation: You use your data skills and customer empathy to weigh competing initiatives, make clear decisions on priorities, and continually re-evaluate your roadmap based on what you learn.

- Collaboration: You build trust across a demanding set of stakeholders — the Paid Search Tech engineering team, the Growth Data Product team, and the Paid Search Marketing team — keeping them aligned on a shared roadmap and clear expectations.

- Experimentation: You use experimentation to evaluate your team's investments, leveraging your data skills to interpret results and decide what to do next.

Your toolkit

- 7+ years of professional experience in product management.

- Demonstrated experience building data products or ML-adjacent products — for example, feature stores, signal pipelines, ML platforms, bidding, pricing, ranking, or attribution systems. You can reason about model-driven products, feedback loops, and guardrails.

- Demonstrated ownership over a product in a previous role, including responsibilities for strategy, KPI setup, goal-setting, and roadmap.

- Strong data analytics skills, with the ability to derive insights from large datasets.

- Experience with experimentation as a core decision-making tool.

- Experience working with large Paid Search setups is a strong plus.

- Experience with Search Engine Optimization is a plus.

- Experience working on a SaaS product, a marketplace, or in the travel industry is a plus.

How we’ll make your career journey extraordinary

- Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development

- Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
